aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparison data but misidentifies the changed factor and produces unusable outcome grouping.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not the tested conditions.
Baseline and changed conditions are left unresolved despite Normal, PW 1470SX-N1, and A-3424B labels.
Key condition evidence omits GRAPH rows for PW 1470SX-N1 and A-3424B.
Outcomes include duplicated and nonsensical raw-data numeric conditions.
Review title is an extracted header row, not a case title.
requiredUserQuestions: Is STD a reference only, with Normal as baseline?
Is the primary change the New Bond material/lot: PW 1470SX-N1 and A-3424B?
Should PW 1470SX-N1 and A-3424B be separate changed conditions under one case?
correctionPlan: Rename case around NTI lot New Bond acoustic result check.
Set baseline to Normal and changed conditions to PW 1470SX-N1 and A-3424B, with STD as reference if applicable.
Cite condition rows RAW DATA!3-8 and summary rows GRAPH!8-11.
Consolidate outcomes to SPL bands, Fo, and THD at 200/400/1000 Hz.
Remove spurious raw-data numeric subresults and duplicate measurement outcomes.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove row existence but are insufficient for final changed-factor and outcome evidence.
